project_execution: Only exact reviewed affirmative simple-past finite surfaces are reinterpreted contextually. No restrictive person value is added to global morphology.
note: For a focused 3pl subject, the restrictive simple past uses the ordinary 3sg-masculine-shaped surface. Thus a reviewed focused plural can agree with yimid/cunay while ordinary non-focus 3pl still requires full forms such as yimaadeen/cuneen. Other focus tenses remain unjudged until separately modeled.
Present, progressive, future and negative focused-subject agreement are not judged from the ordinary full paradigm. Exact sentence-level focus evidence may still license a surface independently.
